svg.text: Sharp patrol turns, default 3-unit line, 13 px per unit
Blue: patrol data. Dashed: each texture's quad. Darker: textures overlapping at the default 50% alpha. Red numbers: concave quads, which the client draws wrong.
Shipped now
Modules/Map/Waypoints as changed: the miter up to 120°, J past it.
Before
Commit 7c1e28bd8: miter tip clamped at 2 half widths; inner corners pulled back up to half the shorter segment.
A. Shorter pull-back
Today's join, but inner corners pulled back at most 2 half widths. One-line change.
B. Square ends at the turn
Past 120° each leg ends square at the turn point. No new textures.
C. Square ends past the turn
Past 120° each leg ends square half a line width past the turn point. No new textures.
D. Bevel
Past 120°: square ends at the turn plus one flat wedge on the outer side. +1 texture per sharp turn.
E. Round
Past 120°: square ends at the turn plus a fan of 30° wedges on the outer side. +5 or 6 textures per sharp turn.
F. Half-circle start cap
Past 120°: square ends at the turn plus a half-disc texture capping the outgoing leg. +1 texture, a plain rectangle quad.
G. Disc cap on a kite
Past 120°: square ends at the turn plus the gap's exact sector of a disc texture. +1 texture, needs 8-value SetTexCoord.
H. Mitered inner corners + half-circle cap
Past 120°: inner corners mitered as today, outer corners square at the turn, F's cap. Red: the uncovered hollow.
I. Mitered inner corners + kite cap
Past 120°: inner corners mitered as today, outer corners square at the turn, G's cap. No overlap anywhere. Red: the hollow.
J. I with the hollow filled
Each leg also gets the triangle between its inner corner, the turn point and its outer corner, with the leg's own rows. +3 textures, 8-value SetTexCoord.
